messages:
lauren: Heads-up — opened a small PR to reconcile Optimize toolkit examples with the SDK v2 batching API. It includes a new KV-prefetch example and a revised quant-profile note because we hit an edge case with 4-bit mixed conv layers. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infer/docs/pulls/4123 :link:

sam: looking now. saw a failing unit test in the CI run, likely related to the sample harness using `prefetch=true` with continuous batching.

alex: that 4-bit conv issue is a known quirk — weight packing in some conv kernels exposes out-of-range scale factors when profile ranges are too tight. short-term fix is to widen the profile min/max for conv layers only.

michael: CI snippet pasted from the failing job: ```
Error: quant profile scale out-of-range for layer conv2d_3: computed scale 0.00000012 < min_profile 0.0001
at runtime/kernel.c:241
```

lauren: thanks — alex can you paste the suggested profile snippet we should include in docs? want to put a small example near the migration guide so customers can adjust profiles without deep diving.

alex: sure. suggestion (inline example for docs):
```json
{
  "quant_profiles": [
    {"scope": "conv*", "min": 0.000001, "max": 0.1},
    {"scope": "linear*", "min": 0.0001, "max": 1.0}
  ]
}
```
explain briefly in copy that conv layers often need a wider min to avoid underflow with 4-bit packers.

sam: also flagged a subtlety in the SDK snippet: when switching from old `batch_size` model to `optimize.batch` the KV-prefetch boolean needs to be under `optimize.kv_prefetch` not top-level. current example has it wrong which triggers a no-op and causes duplicate requests.

lauren: great catch. I pushed a tiny sample fix in the PR that moves `kv_prefetch: true` under `optimize:` — can reviewers confirm?

michael: quick QA note — please add a short test instruction: "run sample_locally.sh --fast-profile" so QA can reproduce the conv underflow. saved me time.

lauren: added that instruction to the PR description. also added a one-line callout: "If you see conv scale < min, widen conv scope in quant_profiles."

sam: ran the corrected sample locally, now passes. no more runtime kernel error. :thumbsup:

alex: LGTM on the content and the example. we should also add a tiny migration checklist entry: 1) move kv_prefetch under optimize, 2) widen conv quant profile, 3) run sample_locally.sh --fast-profile.

lauren: assigning reviewers: @sam and @alex. tagging @docs-bot to run docs linter + linkcheck.

docs-bot: automated check: docs-lint passed, linkcheck found one stale link to `old-optkit.md` (line 78) — recommend replacing with `/optimize/migration-v2.md`.

lauren: fixed the link in a followup commit. can we merge after a final quick pass? would like to ship this in tomorrow's docs deploy.

michael: merging window is 13:00 PT tomorrow, sounds good. I'll queue release if PR gets green. :calendar:
